questions.text: The following figures give the temperature (in °C) of city X for a week in the month of March. Find the arithmetic mean (in °C) of the temperatures by the direct method. Temperature recorded: 32.3, 34.5, 33.1, 32.7, 35.3, 33.2, 34.1 Ans A). 33.8 B). 32.8 C). 33.4 D). 33.6 Correct Answer: D
. B). C). D). Correct Answer: D

A rectangular sheet of paper, 132 cm × 12 cm, is rolled along its length to form a cylinder. Find the volume of the cylinder so formed. Ans A). 16623 cm3 B). 16632 cm3 C). 16326 cm3 D). 16362 cm3 Correct Answer: B

The average sale of cars by a dealer per day in the month of March, other than on Saturdays and Sundays, is 116. The average sale of cars per day on Sundays is 126. What is the average sale of cars per day on Saturdays, if the first Saturday is on the 3rd of March and average sale of cars per day for the whole month is 121? Ans A). 139 B). 143 C). 135 D). 138 Correct Answer: A
The 6-digit number 2A683B is divisible by 3. Find the least possible value of (A+B). Ans A). 11 B). 2 C). 5 D). 8 Correct Answer: B

Pipe C can fill a tank in 10 hours and Pipe D can fill it in 15 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how much time (in hours) will it take to fill the tank? Ans A). 8 B). 6 C). 5 D). 10 Correct Answer: B
Find the smallest number divisible by 5, 10 and 15. Ans A). 45 B). 20 C). 60 D). 30 Correct Answer: D
₹ An individual invests 10,000 at an annual compound interest rate of 5%. Find the total amount after 3 years. Ans A). ₹11,000 B). ₹11,576.25 C). ₹11,200.50 D). ₹12,000 Correct Answer: B

AB is parallel to CD. A transversal PQ intersects AB and CD at E and F, respectively, and ∠PEB = 38°. G is a point between AB and CD such that ∠BEG = 24° and ∠GFE = 29°. What is the measure of ∠EGF? Ans A). 33° B). 47° C). 21° D). 27° Correct Answer: A

A trapezium has parallel sides 18 cm and 12 cm. The height of the trapezium is equal to the average of the lengths of the two parallel sides. What is the area of the trapezium? Ans A). 225 cm2 B). 220 cm2 C). 200 cm2 D). 212 cm2 Correct Answer: A
Select the smallest ratio among following. A- 5 : 7 B- 4 : 5 C- 9 : 10 D- 3 : 4 Ans A). C B). B C). D D). A Correct Answer: D

A sum is invested for 2 years at compound interest, compounded annually. At an annual ₹ interest rate of x%, the amount becomes 24,200. If the annual interest rate is (x + 10)%, ₹ the amount becomes 28,800. What is the value of x? Ans A). 5 B). 10 C). 20 D). 15 Correct Answer: B

Three taps X, Y, and Z can fill a tank in 15 minutes, 12 minutes and 20 minutes, respectively. If Y if kept open all the time whereas X and Z are open for one hour alternately starting with X, then the tank will be filling in: Ans A). 7 hours B). 8 hours C). 6 hours D). 5 hours Correct Answer: A

A, B, C and D are four points in order on a circle such that C is exactly opposite to A and D is exactly opposite to B. Which of the followings is NOT true? Ans A). AC = CD B). AC = BD C). AD = BC D). AB = CD Correct Answer: A

₹ A man has invested 57500 at a rate of 8% per annum simple interest for 4 years. Find ₹ the amount (in ) that he will receive after 4 years. Ans A). 19400 B). 75900 C). 76900 D). 18400 Correct Answer: B
. B). C). D). Correct Answer: B
If 20% of k is 10 less than 1800% of 20, then k is: Ans A). 1750 B). 1710 C). 1730 D). 1790 Correct Answer: A

₹ A shopkeeper bought 6 identical mobile phones for a total of 12,000. He then sold 2 of ₹ these mobile phones for a total of 10,000. What is his gain percentage on the phones sold? Ans A). 150% B). 152% C). 153% D). 148% Correct Answer: A

The sum of the present ages of Tommy and Arthur is 50 years. Four years ago, Arthur's age was half of Tommy's age at that time. What is Tommy's present age (in years)? Ans A). 39 B). 32 C). 28 D). 37 Correct Answer: B

A class is divided into three sections A, B, and C. Section A has 25 students with an average score of 70. Section B has 35 students with an average score of 60. Section C has 40 students. If the combined average score of all 100 students is 63, what is the average score of Section C? Ans A). 58.25 B). 61.25 C). 67.25 D). 64.25 Correct Answer: B
. B). C). D). Correct Answer: B
₹ The cost price of an article is 800. It is sold at a profit of 15%. What is the selling price of the article? Ans A). ₹900 B). ₹880 C). ₹920 D). ₹850 Correct Answer: C

A retailer gives two successive discounts of 3y% and 15% on an item, resulting in a single equivalent discount of 28%. What is the value of y? (Rounded off to the nearest integer) Ans A). 4 B). 6 C). 7 D). 5 Correct Answer: D

Rahul travels three equal distances on his cycle with the speeds of 8 km/hr, 10 km/hr and 15 km/hr and takes a total time of 2 hours 27 minutes. The total distance (in km) covered by him is: Ans A). 28.5 km B). 27.5 km C). 25.2 km D). 27.2 km Correct Answer: C

In a 2520 m circular race, Siddharth finishes one round in 90 seconds and Yash finishes one round in 45 seconds. How many different meeting points are there on the circumference if they are running in the opposite directions?3457 Ans A). 12 B). 9 C). 13 D). 3 Correct Answer: D
